evidence.observation: Stable column profile with monotonic top-down gradient; T705 settled from 76.8 to ~69 °C, consistent with equilibration
Pressure ~598-600 mbar and dP steady, no flooding or blockage signature
Reflux ~0.33 L/h and distillate ~0.25 L/h steady
Reboiler reading ~420-425 °C, implausibly high vs column temps — likely scaling/units artifact, but drifting smoothly and plateauing

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition (GC) measurement; also confirmation of T701 calibration/units to rule out reboiler thermocouple misreading.
